summary: Added cancellation guards in src/telegram/goal-commands.ts so handleGoal returns "Goal was stopped." when goalCommand outcome or persisted run state is cancelled before autocheck/plan delivery, and hardened markRunAwaitingApproval to reload latest run and no-op for cancelled runs. Added regression test in src/telegram/goal-commands.test.ts to verify cancelled planning skips autocheck and keeps run state cancelled. Verified with pnpm vitest run src/telegram/goal-commands.test.ts, pnpm build, and pnpm lint.
